206:t_1:173.en:
$$恭子$$
「Is everyone coming to the closing ceremony?」

206:t_1:175.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Whoa, whoa! What are you saying, $$相良$$?!」

206:t_1:176.en:
$$詩織$$
「Get a grip. Ten years from now is one thing, but you should at least know about tomorrow!」

206:t_1:179.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$... I need to talk to you...」

206:t_1:181.en:
$$恭子$$
「Go on, $$カナ$$. There's still time before we start preparing for the ceremony.」

206:t_1:183.en:
$$宗介$$
(What... am I going to say to $$千鳥$$...?)

206:t_1:189.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I thought you hadn't gone to school. And here you are, just as I thought...」

206:t_1:190.en:
$n
「What about you, Miss $$スズネ$$? Should you be coming here?」

206:t_1:191.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's a teacher's duty to get students to go to school too.」

206:t_1:192.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Though that part of my job ends tomorrow.」

206:t_1:194.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n, about Nurse... Have you come to terms with that?」

206:t_1:197.en:
$n
「Apparently around January this year. I'm sure she was busy with that and couldn't reply to my emails.」

206:t_1:200.en:
$n
「She was always upset about 《$$シンヤ#keyword$$》 and 《$$ミサコ#keyword$$》, so that may be why she quit nursing...」

206:t_1:201.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But didn't you say those children were recovering...?」

206:t_1:204.en:
$n
「I... don't think I understood anything... about $$マキ#pilot$$... And I'm sure it wasn't just her...」

206:t_1:205.en:
$n
「My friends in $c, you, Miss $$スズネ$$, and even myself...」

206:t_1:206.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No one fully understands themselves. I'm the same way...」

206:t_1:208.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'll be honest. I'm... relieved that $$マキ#pilot$$ is gone from your life...」

206:t_1:210.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know why... But something inside me... wants you...」

206:t_1:211.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm scared, $n... There are so many things... I don't understand either...」

206:t_1:212.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What is this anxiety I keep feeling...? Does the answer lie far beyond Emperor $$アウストラリス$$, whom we saw at $$ラース・バビロン$$...?」

206:t_1:214.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You must feel it too, $n. The same anxiety I do...」

206:t_1:215.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Tell me... Is the world... going to end?」

206:t_1:218.en:
$$傭兵$$
「If I'd known this would happen, I'd have just used a gun to get it over with.」

206:t_1:222.en:
$$傭兵$$
「Impossible... He was faster... than I could draw...」

206:t_1:224.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That was reckless! Using $$ブーストアップ$$ when your body is so exhausted!」

206:t_1:225.en:
$n
「I know it was dangerous... But I had to do it.」

206:t_1:226.en:
$$スズネ$$
(This feeling from $n... It's the same... as at $$ラース・バビロン$$...)

206:t_1:227.en:
$n
「They were... definitely here to kill us... Not capture us...」

206:t_1:229.en:
$n
「I think $$アマルガム$$ would use tactics like this...」

206:t_1:231.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$ and $$千鳥$$... are in danger...」

206:t_1:235.en: ～$$陣代高校$$　$$ボランティア部$$ Room～

206:t_1:237.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Sounds like it was rough. But I'm glad you came back, $$宗介$$.」

206:t_1:240.en:
$$宗介$$
「...If only we could stay together like this forever...」

206:t_1:243.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well... I wouldn't hate it, but...」

206:t_1:247.en:
???
「...There's no need to say what comes next, $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

206:t_1:250.en:
$$レナード$$
「Let me introduce myself. I'm $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

206:t_1:252.en:
$$レナード$$
「You intend to use a firearm in this sacred place of learning?」

206:t_1:253.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't fuck with me, you $$アマルガム$$ executive...!」

206:t_1:254.en:
$$宗介$$
「Slowly raise both hands right where you are. If you don't...」

206:t_1:255.en:
$$レナード$$
「You'll shoot me dead... right? Let's skip the familiar diplomatic ritual. That sort of threat is outdated.」

206:t_1:257.en:
$$レナード$$
「You can't, $$相良宗介$$. You seem to be a fairly capable killer, but...」
